data.description: The Fun Rower copies a rowing action outdoors, with an orange seat and footrests. The user sits, braces the feet and pulls the handles towards the chest, then lets them go back, working the back, arms and legs in one smooth movement. Because it is seated and steady, it suits a wide group, from office staff on a campus to retired residents in a society. It is finished in Play Orange as part of our Fun Fitness range. Ask our sales team for its footprint and warranty terms before you plan the layout. For the Fun Rower, the warranty will be confirmed with your quote; our usual terms cover galvanised pipes for 3 years and bearings for 1 year. Ask us for a layout that groups it with other machines.

items.pText: The Fun Rower copies a rowing action outdoors, with an orange seat and footrests. The user sits, braces the feet and pulls the handles towards the chest, then lets them go back, working the back, arms and legs in one smooth movement. Because it is seated and steady, it suits a wide group, from office staff on a campus to retired residents in a society. It is finished in Play Orange as part of our Fun Fitness range. Ask our sales team for its footprint and warranty terms before you plan the layout. For the Fun Rower, the warranty will be confirmed with your quote; our usual terms cover galvanised pipes for 3 years and bearings for 1 year. Ask us for a layout that groups it with other machines.

The rowing arm moves on pivots, which are the parts to inspect and grease. The Fun Rower can be self-standing or grouted. Set it on a level base so the seat sits square, and leave room at the front where the handles travel.
